notes: Linked from https://www.askitalian.co.uk/allergens (needs fetch_protected). IMPORTANT: generic_pdf.parse_pdf FAILS here (returns 29 junk rows whose names are section headings) because the tables have no ruling lines and pdfplumber's extract_tables cannot see them. Parsed instead from page TEXT: each data line is '<Menu Section> <Dish> ' followed by exactly 16 numbers - cols 0-7 Per 100g (kJ, kcal, fat, sat, carb, sugar, protein, salt) and cols 8-15 Per Portion (same order). kcal=index 9, protein=index 14 give per-portion values. 348 rows pass the protein*4<=kcal*1.15 gate. Names still carry the menu-section prefix and long dish names wrap, so a name-continuation fix is needed. Sibling PDF c476e315..= 'Concept Stores' menu, same layout. A working text parser is at scratchpad/ask_parse.py.
